pages.name: English: Symmetrical, Botvinnik System, 5...d6, 8.d3
pages.notes: Overview called it a double fianchetto; plan 4 rerouted the e2-knight via c1 (the bishop's square) and g1-f3-d4; plan 3 put a white knight on d4, which Black controls. Rewrote overview and plans 3-4.

pages.name: English: Symmetrical, Botvinnik, 5...d6 6.Nge2
pages.notes: Plan 1 made d2-d4 White's main plan in a d3 Botvinnik; plan 2 read d4 as a Black move. Rewrote plans 1-2; British spelling.

pages.name: English: Symmetrical, Botvinnik, 5...e6
pages.notes: Plan 2 read d4 as a Black move; plan 3 sent White's knight to d4 (controlled by c5, Nc6 and Bg7); overview said the sides mirror each other. Rewrote overview and plans 1-3.

pages.name: English: Symmetrical, Botvinnik, 5...e6, 8.d3 d6
pages.notes: Plan 3 routed a knight Nge7-g8-h6; overview said the sides mirror each other. Rewrote overview and plan 3.

pages.name: English: Symmetrical, 5.Nf3 d6 6.O-O Nh6
pages.notes: Plan 4 wrote the diagonal as a move (h1-a8). Fixed plan 4; British spelling.

pages.name: English: Symmetrical, 5.Nf3 e5 6.O-O d6 7.d3 Nge7 8.a3
pages.notes: Overview called a c5/d6/e5 Botvinnik set-up a Hedgehog; plan 2 read b4 as a Black move and aimed at an unrealistic ...d5; plan 4 was a vague endgame line. Rewrote overview and plans 2 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: English: Symmetrical, 5.Nf3 e6
pages.notes: Plan 4 rerouted a knight via Nc3-e2-d4. Rewrote plan 4; British spelling.

pages.name: English: Symmetrical, 5.Nf3 e6 6.d3
pages.notes: Plan 4 read g2 and g7 as moves; plan 3 proposed an h4-h5 attack that is not this line's plan. Rewrote plans 3-4; British spelling.

pages.name: English: Symmetrical, 5.Nf3 e6 6.O-O Nge7 7.d3 O-O
pages.notes: Plan 4 sent the e7-knight to c8, where the bishop stands; plan 2 and the overview called it a Hedgehog. Rewrote overview and plans 1, 2 and 4. Reviewer rejection (the f3-knight blocks the g2-bishop from d5) fixed and re-reviewed.

pages.name: English: Symmetrical, 5.Nf3 e6 6.O-O Nge7 7.e3
pages.notes: Plan 4 had Black capture ...exd4 with no e5-pawn; plan 3 said ...Ng6 challenges the f3-knight. Rewrote plans 3-4; British spelling.
